cards.ex: That cat video is going viral; everyone's sharing it!
cards.exUz: O'sha mushuk videosi juda tez tarqalmoqda; hamma ulashmoqda!
cards.uzDef: Internetda juda tez va keng tarqalish, ommalashib ketish.

cards.ex: The marketing team is really hyping up the new product launch.
cards.exUz: Marketing guruhi yangi mahsulotning chiqarilishini juda qizdirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda ko'p maqtab, qiziqish uyg'otish.

cards.ex: Our target audience for this campaign is young adults.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kampaniya uchun bizning maqsadli auditoriyamiz yoshlar.
cards.uzDef: Reklama yoki mahsulot yo'naltirilgan odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: Social media is great for increasing brand awareness.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media brend xabardorligini oshirish uchun juda yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning brend haqida bilishi va tanishi darajasi.

cards.ex: The event received extensive media coverage.
cards.exUz: Tadbir ommaviy axborot vositalarida keng yoritildi.
cards.uzDef: Hodisa yoki voqeani ommaviy axborot vositalarida yoritilishi.

cards.ex: They hired a spin doctor to improve their public image.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z imidjini yaxshilash uchun so'z ustasini yollashdi.
cards.uzDef: Axborotni o'z foydasiga buradigan shaxs, manipulyator.

cards.ex: The company's new catchy slogan really resonated with customers.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning yangi esda qolar shiori mijozlarga juda yoqdi.
cards.uzDef: Oson esda qoladigan va diqqatni tortadigan shior.

cards.ex: Word of mouth is still one of the best forms of advertising.
cards.exUz: Og'zaki reklama hali ham eng yaxshi reklama turlaridan biri.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning o'zaro bir-biriga aytishi orqali tarqaladigan reklama.

cards.ex: The magazine is going to print next week.
cards.exUz: Jurnal kelasi hafta bosmaga topshiriladi.
cards.uzDef: Nashr etish uchun bosmaxonaga yuborish (matn, rasm va h.k.).

cards.ex: The celebrity plugged the product on her Instagram account.
cards.exUz: Mashhur shaxs o'zining Instagram sahifasida mahsulotni reklama qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror mahsulotni reklama qilish, targ'ib qilish.

cards.ex: Several news outlets reported on the scandal.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta axborot manbalari bu janjal haqida xabar berdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangiliklar tarqatuvchi tashkilot yoki platforma.

cards.ex: The royal wedding caused a media frenzy.
cards.exUz: Qirollik to'yi ommaviy hayajonga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining biror voqeaga juda katta qiziqishi.

cards.ex: Everyone's jumping on the bandwagon with this new social media app.
cards.exUz: Hamma bu yangi ijtimoiy media ilovasi modasiga ergashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ommabop narsaga qo'shilish, trendga ergashish.

cards.ex: Viral marketing can be very effective if done right.
cards.exUz: Viral marketing to'g'ri amalga oshirilsa, juda samarali bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar orasida tez tarqaladigan marketing usuli.

cards.ex: Be careful of clickbait headlines; they're often misleading.
cards.exUz: Sarlavha-aldamchilardan ehtiyot bo'ling; ular ko'pincha chalg'itadi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni tortish uchun yaratilgan, lekin ko'pincha yolg'on sarlavha.

cards.ex: We're going to run an ad during the Super Bowl.
cards.exUz: Biz Super Bowl paytida reklama beramiz.
cards.uzDef: Reklamani efirga uzatmoq yoki chop etmoq.

cards.ex: Good public relations is crucial for any company.
cards.exUz: Har qanday kompaniya uchun yaxshi jamoatchilik bilan aloqalar juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Jamoatchilik bilan munosabatlarni o'rnatish va saqlash.

cards.ex: The politician's sound bite was played repeatedly on the news.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining qisqa lavhasi yangiliklarda qayta-qayta namoyish etildi.
cards.uzDef: Axborot dasturida ishlatiladigan qisqa nutq yoki bayonot.

cards.ex: He's a media mogul with holdings in television and newspapers.
cards.exUz: U televizor va gazetalarda ulushlarga ega bo'lgan media magnati.
cards.uzDef: Katta media kompaniyalariga egalik qiluvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: We need to get the word out about the event.
cards.exUz: Biz tadbir haqida xabarni tarqatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida ko'pchilikka xabar berish.

cards.ex: That was clearly a paid advertisement, not an objective review.
cards.exUz: Bu shubhasiz pulli reklama edi, ob'ektiv sharh emas.
cards.uzDef: Reklama uchun pul to'langan e'lon.

cards.ex: The changes were just window dressing; nothing really improved.
cards.exUz: O'zgarishlar shunchaki ko'zbo'yamachilik edi; hech narsa haqiqatan ham yaxshilanmadi.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli, lekin ahamiyatsiz narsalar bilan bezash, asl holatni yashirish.

cards.ex: The show will be on the air next week.
cards.exUz: Ko'rsatuv kelasi hafta efirda bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Radio yoki televideniye orqali translyatsiya qilish.

cards.ex: The company issued a press release about the new product.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi mahsulot haqida press-reliz chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalari uchun tayyorlangan rasmiy xabar.

cards.ex: He was a victim of cancel culture after his old tweets resurfaced.
cards.exUz: Uning eski tvitlari qayta paydo bo'lganidan so'ng, u bekor qilish madaniyatining qurboni bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xatosi uchun shaxsni ommaviy ravishda tanqid qilib, jamiyatdan chetlatish.

cards.ex: The campaign is starting to get traction on social media.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda ommaviylasha boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Ommalashish, mashhur bo'lish, e'tiborni qozonish.

cards.ex: The company has built strong brand loyalty over the years.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yillar davomida kuchli brendga sodiqlikni yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Mijozlarning bir brendga sodiq bo'lishi.

cards.ex: Demographic targeting helps to reach the right audience.
cards.exUz: Demografik maqsad to'g'ri auditoriyaga erishishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Reklamani demografik ma'lumotlar asosida tanlash.

cards.ex: The advertisement was a real attention grabber.
cards.exUz: Reklama haqiqiy diqqat tortuvchi edi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning diqqatini tortadigan narsa.

cards.ex: A lot of work goes on behind the scenes to produce a TV show.
cards.exUz: Televizion ko'rsatuvni tayyorlash uchun sahna ortida ko'p ish qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaga ko'rinmaydigan joyda, yashirincha.
